newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southern Star in video alliance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southern Star in video alliance.

text.p: Southern Star Group Ltd said on Monday it had entered into a technical alliance with Pioneer Electronic Corp unit Pioneer Video Corp for a A$12 million plant to make compact discs and digital video discs.
Southern Star unit Southern Star Duplitek, which duplicates audio and video tapes, said a new plant at its Sydney headquarters would be commissioned by July 1997.
Digital video discs are a new type of digital video system designed to play movies, music and software.
Southern Star Duplitek general manager Nigel Price said Marubeni Australia Ltd, a subsidiary of Marubeni Corp, would supply the Pioneer-developed mastering system and manufacturing equipment.
